mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates signal deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 1-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance supports equity market expansion through lower discount rates and increased liquidity, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation, measured by a 12-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5%, prompts expectations of monetary tightening, reducing equity market returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts serve as a leading indicator of economic expansion, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and payroll employment indicate a weakening economic cycle, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS are below their 1-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0), economic uncertainty suppresses risk appetite and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0.
